name: Validate Drug Quantity
action_description: Validates the structure, types, and enum values of a refill extraction JSON string

inputs.name: refill_extraction_json
inputs.label: Refill Extraction JSON
inputs.description: JSON string output from the refill extraction step to validate

outputs.name: invalid_json
outputs.label: Invalid JSON
outputs.description: True if the input failed validation, false if it passed

outputs.name: quantity
outputs.label: Quantity
outputs.description: Extracted medication quantity (only set when validation passes)

outputs.name: frequency
outputs.label: Frequency (Days)
outputs.description: Extracted frequency in days - one of 30, 60, 90, 180, 360 (only set when validation passes)

outputs.name: refill_extraction_notes
outputs.label: Refill Extraction Notes
outputs.description: Extraction notes from the validated output (only set when validation passes)
